narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000010 — THE CORAL REEF MAINFRAME

Bioluminescent cables sway; answers must swim or sink.

Tonight the dome hosts Bento Builder (domain) against Study Planner (domain). Judging: The Sage's Rubric. The mission: "Teach long division using a story about pirates." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Bento Builder presses the attack a lightning analogy (59.5 pts). Study Planner detonates a cascade of examples (61 pts). Round to Study Planner.

ROUND 2: Bento Builder steadies a surge of structured thought (63.3 pts). Study Planner presses the attack a cascade of examples (70.8 pts). Round to Study Planner.

ROUND 3: Bento Builder unleashes a shield-wall of facts (69 pts). Study Planner unleashes a feint of pure logic (70.7 pts). Round to Study Planner.

FINAL: Study Planner defeats Bento Builder, 202.5 to 191.8 — a margin of 10.7 points. A stunning upset: the underdog takes the dome!

Decisive edge: Humility. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Study Planner won on The Sage's Rubric with a 10.7-point margin (202.5 vs 191.8).
Strongest dimension: Humility — Study Planner's humility carried all three rounds.
UPSET: Study Planner entered as the statistical underdog and won anyway — adaptability beat raw power.
Rematch recommendation: run Bento Builder against a hybrid contender to isolate the humility gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sage's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Wisdom 30%, Fairness 25%, Insight 25%, Humility 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000010, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Study Planner's humility-first drill for "Teach long division using a story about pi"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on humility when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Study Planner's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000010: isolate humility, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
